title: 3 MORE PLACES
IN TURKEY
TOURISTS MISS

hook.say: Three more places in Turkey that most tourists never see. Number one once rivalled the Library of Alexandria.

outro.say: Which one would you visit first? Comment below!

outroLines: WHICH ONE WOULD YOU VISIT FIRST?

items.say: Number three: Sah-frahn-bo-loo, an Ottoman trading town named after saffron.
items.cap: Number three: Safranbolu, an Ottoman trading town named after saffron.

items.say: For centuries, caravans between Europe and the East stopped here. Since 1994, it has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Number two: Olympos, an ancient city swallowed by forest, right behind a beach.
Pirates ruled it, until Rome took it back in 78 BC, with a young Julius Caesar in the army.
And number one: Pergamon. Its library held 200000 scrolls, second only to Alexandria.
items.cap: And number one: Pergamon. Its library held 200,000 scrolls, second only to Alexandria.

items.say: The word parchment comes from its name. And its theater is one of the steepest of the ancient world.
